title: TeamCity console is reachable without authentication
description: The TeamCity web interface is served without authentication. TeamCity stores build configurations, VCS credentials and artifact publishing targets, and its agents run build scripts.
remediation: Complete the TeamCity setup behind the internal network, disable guest access, and never expose the server port publicly.
limitation: One response body. The rule recognises the TeamCity console shell from its document title; it does not attempt a login, so it shows that the interface is served, not which data the caller could read.

observation.body: <html><head><title>Sign in · TeamCity</title></head><body><form method="post" action="/login"><input name="user"><input type="password" name="pass"><button>Sign in</button></form></body></html>
